Why integrate Degreed & iMocha?
Together with Degreed & iMocha, you gain the ability to identify the critical skills within your organization, build the skills required to achieve business outcomes, and engage your talent with personalized learning journeys.
Engage talent for better retention
Identify and nurture high-potential employees, track skills, and foster a thriving and engaged workforce.
Make talent build or buy decisions
Make informed decisions about resource allocation and hiring to meet business or organization’s strategic goals.
Automate personalized learning
Provide automated personalized learning material based on individual skill gaps & career aspirations.
Facilitate better career planning & mobility
Encourage professional growth and align aspirations of employees with your organization's needs.
Evaluate learners through multiple channels
Build program reports into Degreed Pathways with skills assessment, performance rating & participation analytics.
Promote learning in the flow of work
Empower employees to take charge of their skill development and access diverse learning modes.
How iMocha and Degreed Work Together
While Degreed Learning Experience Platform provides learners with access to limitless content sources, iMocha aggregates rich skill from siloed sources along with Degreed learning data to provide a complete view of learners’ skills and job profile performance.

Manage multi-channel skill validation including self, manager & AI-inferred
